metadata.title: Nangur Tribal market of Bastar | बस्तर के घने जंगल में आदिवासी बाज़ार
metadata.description: Chhattisgarh's Bastar region is known for the diverse culture and life style of tribals. The local market is the place where you can meet the tribals of different communities and villages. In these market you get fruits, vegetables and local whine made by tribal women. The rice beer and Chapda chutney (Ant sauce) is the ultimate combination, which every one likes to taste.
